metas.name: A Good Girl's Guide to Murder
metas.description: With cold case murders and new mysteries looming over her sleepy English town, an average teen becomes an amateur sleuth determined to uncover the truth.

metas.name: Beyond the Gates
metas.description: A powerful and prestigious family reigns over a posh gated community with juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered.

metas.name: Hogan's Heroes
metas.description: From a German prisoner of war camp during World War II, Colonel Robert E. Hogan coordinates an international crew of Allied prisoners running a Special Operations group.

metas.name: Love Story
metas.description: An anthology of sweeping true love stories that captured the world’s attention.

metas.name: Extraordinary
metas.description: In a world where everyone develops a power on their 18th birthday, Jen didn't. She's turning 25 and is still waiting to get hers. Adrift in a big, confusing world and armed with nothing but a bit of hope and a lot of desperation, Jen begins her journey to find her maybe-superpower. But in doing so, she might discover the joy of being just kind of ok.

metas.name: Misfits
metas.description: When five young outsiders on Community Service get caught in a strange storm, they discover that they have developed superpowers.

metas.name: Next Level Baker
metas.description: Talented bakers compete through three challenging rounds, crafting spectacular seasonal treats. Only one will emerge victorious and be crowned the ultimate holiday champion.

metas.name: Yellowjackets
metas.description: A wildly talented girls' high school soccer team become the unlucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Canadian wilderness.

metas.name: The Pacific
metas.description: Track the intertwined real-life stories of three U.S. Marines – Robert Leckie, John Basilone, and Eugene Sledge – across the vast canvas of the Pacific Theater during World War II. A companion piece to the 2001 miniseries Band of Brothers.

metas.name: 24 in 24: Last Chef Standing
metas.description: Food Network's most ambitious and grueling culinary competition to date. Featuring 24 talented and fearless chefs who take on 24 food challenges in 24 consecutive, non-stop hours, the 24-hour competition takes the chefs to the extreme, demanding they display the skills, creativity and stamina needed to be an elite chef. At the end of the 24 hours, there can be only one true master left standing.

metas.name: The Seduction
metas.description: Marquise de Merteuil, betrayed by Valmont, embarks on a daring journey to become Paris' leading courtesan.

metas.name: Dig
metas.description: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

metas.name: Mystery Science Theater 3000
metas.description: A stranded spaceship pilot captured by mad scientists survives a blitz of cheesy B movies by riffing on them with his funny robot pals.

metas.name: Prosecuting Evil with Kelly Siegler
metas.description: A true-crime series examining the most shocking murder investigations and toughest trials in Texas history - all told with Kelly's unique insight and unparalleled access. As Chief of Special Crimes in the busiest courthouse in the Lone Star state, Kelly Siegler battled to get killers into courtrooms to face their formidable defense attorneys. With her own firsthand accounts, alongside investigators and victims' families, Kelly reveals what really happened beyond the newspaper headlines to bring Texas-style justice.

metas.name: Prey
metas.description: Three-part crime thriller. When detective Marcus Farrow looks into a seemingly forgotten case, he has no idea of the chaos and heartache that will soon follow. He is found at the scene of a murder, and with all the evidence pointing towards him, he is arrested and charged.

metas.name: American Monster
metas.description: Monsters can be found lurking behind any innocent smile and on any street corner in America. Never-before-seen-video footage stares straight into the eyes of these killers who hide in plain sight. Anyone can be a monster.

metas.name: Go On
metas.description: Ryan King, a recent widower and sports talk radio host ready to get back to work after the loss of his wife. Ryan's alpha-male boss, Stephen, has a different plan in store for Ryan, making him attend grief counseling before returning to the air. A reluctant Ryan finds himself in a support group for "life change," where he meets an oddball cast of characters, all with their own backstories filled with varying degrees of loss.
